t: You're looking at the Former Pump House, in the EC3R area of Tower Hamlets. It was designed by Anthony Salvin, an English architect. Salvin gained a reputation as an expert on medieval buildings, and he applied that knowledge to new buildings and to restorations, including work on the Tower of London and Windsor Castle. He also restored castles and country houses and built houses and churches. So a specialist in the medieval was behind this building.
